prog='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fgset = [v for v in Counter(v for r in grid for v in r) if v != bg]
    o = [r[:] for r in grid]
    for i in range(len(grid)):
        for j in range(1, len(grid[0]) - 1):
            if grid[i][j] == bg and grid[i][j-1] in fgset and grid[i][j+1] in fgset:
                o[i][j] = 2
    return o
'''
